days.w: Any day with at least one trade

dd.lockW: Minimum Account Balance follows the highest end-of-day balance up and stops trailing once it reaches the starting balance ($25,000), i.e. after an end-of-day balance of $26,500.

cons.w: Highest profit day's net P/L divided by total net P/L must be below 50% (strictly). Not a failure: the profit goal adjusts automatically and is shown in the dashboard.

dd.lockW: Trails the intraday peak balance including unrealized gains and stops once the minimum balance reaches the starting balance ($25,000), i.e. after a peak of $26,500.

news.w: Must have no open positions and no working orders from 1 minute before until 1 minute after prohibited news: FOMC statements/announcements (Wednesdays 2:00 PM ET; Fed speakers and minutes allowed), Non-Farm Payroll (Fridays 8:30 AM ET), CPI. Track via ForexFactory red-folder USD events and the TPT trader calendar.
